WITH female_districts AS (

        d."district_id",
        d."a11" AS avg_salary,

    JOIN "client" c ON c."district_id" = d."district_id"

    FROM "client" c

    SELECT DISTINCT c."district_id"
    FROM "client" c
    JOIN oldest o ON c."birth_date" = o."min_birth_date"
    WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
),

    SELECT fd."avg_salary"
    FROM female_districts fd
    JOIN oldest_districts od ON od."district_id" = fd."district_id"
),

salary_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(fd."avg_salary") AS min_salary,
        MAX(fd."avg_salary") AS max_salary
    FROM female_districts fd
),

target_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a."account_id"
    FROM "account" a
    JOIN "disp" dp ON dp."account_id" = a."account_id"
    JOIN "client" c ON c."client_id" = dp."client_id"
    JOIN oldest_districts od ON od."district_id" = c."district_id"
    JOIN female_districts fd ON fd."district_id" = c."district_id"
    JOIN salary_bounds sb ON fd."avg_salary" = sb."min_salary"
    WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
)

    sb."max_salary" - sb."min_salary" AS salary_gap
FROM target_accounts ta

WITH consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM consumption_by_year
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        ("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") AS "increase",
        CASE
            WHEN "consumption_2013" IS NOT NULL AND "consumption_2013" <> 0
            THEN (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2013") * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM pivoted
)

SELECT
    'biggest' AS "category",
    "segment",
    "consumption_2012",
    "consumption_2013",
    "increase",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM changes
WHERE "percentage_increase" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'lowest' AS "category",
    "segment",
    "consumption_2012",
    "consumption_2013",
    "increase",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM changes
WHERE "percentage_increase" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
